title: Farmers
intro: Approve an application before the stall can list products. Most applications come from accounts that already shop here, so each one carries the applicant's order history next to their photos. Suspend a stall to hide its products and stop new orders; its running orders finish as normal.

pending.title: No registrations waiting
pending.text: New Farmer applications arrive here for review before they can list products.

approved.title: No approved stalls
approved.text: Approve a registration and the stall appears here, visible to customers.

suspended.title: No suspended stalls
suspended.text: A suspended stall is hidden from customers but finishes the orders it already has.

rejected.title: No rejected registrations
rejected.text: Rejected Farmers keep their account and can be told why.

approve.title: Approve {{stall}}?
approve.text: The stall becomes visible to customers and can list products right away. The Farmer is notified.

reject.title: Reject {{stall}}?
reject.text: The Farmer keeps their sign-in but cannot list products.

reason.mismatch: Details do not match the stall
reason.unreachable: Could not reach the contact number

suspend.title: Suspend {{stall}}?
suspend.text: All products are hidden and no new orders are accepted. Orders already placed continue so customers do not lose what they booked.

toast.approved: {{stall}} approved. The stall can list products now.
toast.suspended: {{stall}} suspended. Running orders finish as normal.
